operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: IDF Launches Day 1 of Renewed Gaza Campaign; 188th Brigade Destroys Hamas Tunnel Network as Rafah Evacuations Begin
heroSubtitle: Israel's renewed military campaign began on May 11, 2026 (Day 943), one day after the security cabinet formally authorized the IDF to resume large-scale operations following Hamas's categorical rejection of the Board of Peace disarmament framework. The IDF's 188th Brigade and Yahalom combat engineering unit destroyed four Hamas tunnel structures totaling ~2.5 miles in southern Gaza east of the Yellow Line — including a tunnel previously used to hold Israeli hostages and quarters of Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commanders. The Kfir Infantry Brigade simultaneously destroyed two tunnel routes (~1.2 miles) in central Gaza. Israel issued evacuation orders for eastern Rafah, directing ~100,000 civilians to designated humanitarian areas ahead of anticipated ground advances. The October 2025 ceasefire — which had held 212 days despite 870+ Palestinian deaths — is now formally over. Gaza's death toll stands at 72,736+ killed and 172,574+ wounded since October 7, 2023. Humanitarian organizations warned that Gaza's health system, operating at under 30% capacity, cannot absorb new war casualties.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, Palestine Info, JNS, Jerusalem Post, and UN DPPA. Gaza death toll: 72,736+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (Gaza MoH / Palestine Info / WAFA, May 10–11, 2026). 870+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire. IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026; Day 1 of renewed campaign launched May 11. IDF 188th Brigade and Yahalom unit destroyed four Hamas tunnel structures (~2.5 miles) east of Yellow Line in southern Gaza including one used to hold hostages. Kfir Brigade destroyed 2 additional tunnel routes in central Gaza. Eastern Rafah evacuation orders issued (~100,000 civilians). Board of Peace halted field monitoring in conflict zones. 14,222 bodies remain under rubble. Only 17 of 36 hospitals partially functional. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only ~10% funded. Day 943 of war.
